verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Pure and spotless, sent from heaven
For the broken You came
Your life was the ransom that paid
The debt that saved me from the grave

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
See His love at the cross
He embraced the shame for us
See His hands, open wide
Giving guilty ones His life
Sinners born as friends of God at the cross
Sinners born as sons of God at the cross

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Come, you weary, come, you suffering
He will lift up your head
Though once far away without hope
He opened the way to bring us close

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Believe in Him, Son of the highest
Call Him Lord, our righteousness
The orphan curse has now been broken
Sons of God are home again
